text:
Priya K: Opening origination for RC rc-2026-03-21-b. Artifacts pinned to sha: b7c4d2. Change window 22:30-23:30 UTC. Need KV priming, canary plan, and a sheriff.
Sam (infra): I can handle routing pin and KV priming. Will switch routing-rule to stable-v3.
Eve - QA: I'll run quick smoke (chat, streaming, edge-cases) and surface any blockers in 10m.
Noah - oncall: I'll be sheriff for the window. Rollback thresholds: error rate >1% for 3m OR p95 latency >300ms sustained 7m => trigger rollback. Escalation: if rollback happens, notify SRE + infra lead.
Ravi: Release notes draft at https://notion.redwood/notes/rc-2026-03-21-b. Contains model tweak and small config cleanup.
deploy-bot: Origination queued. Command accepted:
```
/promote rc-2026-03-21-b --pin=b7c4d2 --canary=3 --kv-prime
```
Sam (infra): kicked KV priming job kvprime-129 at 22:34 UTC. Logs streaming: https://logs.redwood/kvprime-129. Expected warm coverage ~95% of hot prefixes.
deploy-bot: Canary started 22:36 UTC (3% traffic). Initial metrics: p95=95ms, errors=0.1%.
Eve - QA: smoke pass 1. Minor diff in tokenization on a rare path, creating ticket TKT-998. Not blocking. Recommend hold at 15% for 8m to watch latency trends.
Priya K: Agree hold at 15% for 8m. Tagging eng-runtime and infra.
Sam (infra): widened to 15% at 22:42 UTC. Holding per plan.
deploy-bot: Canary hold active. Auto-monitor running.
Noah - oncall: watching dashboards. If error >1% for 3m I'll execute rollback.
deploy-bot: After 8m hold metrics stable. p95=110ms, errors=0.12%. No alerts.
Sam (infra): proceeding to 60% ramp and will flip dbflag rollout -> enabled. KV prime reports 96% coverage.
deploy-bot: Widened to 60% at 22:51 UTC.
Ravi: Quick smoke on 60% looks fine. Noting slight rerank score distribution shift; non-blocking, tracked under TKT-1001.
Noah - oncall: All green. Proceed to full rollout.
Sam (infra): promoting to 100% now, routing unpinned from stable-v3 -> target sha b7c4d2.
deploy-bot: Promotion to 100% complete at 23:05 UTC. Nodes healthy.
Priya K: PROD promotion completed. Summary: pinned sha b7c4d2, KV primed (kvprime-129), canary 3% -> 15% -> 60% -> 100%. Rollback target sha before promo was a1d2e3. Rollback command if required:
```
/promote rollback --to-sha=a1d2e3 --reason="prod-regression"
```
Priya K: Follow-ups: TKT-998 tokenization edge-case, TKT-1001 rerank distribution. If any regression observed later, we'll open postmortem. Thanks team :rocket:
